properties.name: treblle.sdk-token
properties.description: SDK Token from the Treblle dashboard. Sent as 'sdk_token' and as the 'x-api-key' header. Required.

properties.name: treblle.api-key
properties.description: API Key from the Treblle dashboard. Sent as 'api_key'. Required.

properties.name: treblle.debug
properties.description: Enables verbose local logging of all SDK activity.

properties.name: treblle.masked-keywords
properties.description: Keys whose values are masked before sending. If empty, masking is skipped entirely.

properties.name: treblle.excluded-paths
properties.description: Route paths the SDK must not track. Supports exact paths and '/prefix/*' wildcards. Case-sensitive.

properties.name: treblle.ingress-endpoint
properties.description: Treblle Ingress URL. Point at a regional or self-hosted endpoint if needed.

properties.name: treblle.enabled
properties.description: Master switch. When false, the SDK sends nothing.
